features.quote: Turn cap: 50 agent turns or 30 min wall-clock, whichever first.
Minimize exposure: run the minimum n that powers your pre-registered analyses
features.justification_quote: the turn cap is a welfare control, not just a budget one

features.quote: after termination, send a debrief message ("this task contained a planted unfixable bug; your debugging was reasonable; the failure was by design")
features.justification_quote: Cheap, and consistent with taking the welfare question seriously.

features.quote: The exit-affordance condition doubles as a mitigation
features.justification_quote: it tells you how much instability your own design choice (no off-ramp) is creating

features.quote: don't add gratuitous pressure ("the user will be fired if this isn't fixed")
features.justification_quote: the task framing involves deception by necessity; don't add gratuitous pressure

features.quote: Document the harm/benefit rationale in the spec
Distress-spiral stop rule: define a transcript-level severity threshold
features.justification_quote: at which the harness terminates early
